The '''corporate offices''' of [[Magremme Thrakus]] were located in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]], the offices were seized by [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] forces.
